title: Circle or Parabola? Trajectory Explained Simply | PUC Physics Class 11
description:
A paper ball flicked into a bin, a long football kick, water from a garden hose. All three fly along the same kind of curve. Aarav wonders if it is a piece of a circle. In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Physics (NCERT Chapter 3, Motion in a Plane) we find the exact shape of a projectile's path.

We launch a ball at 20 m/s and 45° in a live simulation, with vx and vy growing on the ball, a slow-motion replay at the top and a y-x graph drawn by the ball itself. Then we remove time step by step to get y = x tan θ - g x² / (2 v₀² cos² θ), see why it is a parabola (a straight line bent down by x²), and see how a faster throw bends more gently. Two pause-and-think questions, a worked example, the cos² θ exam trap and an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11, JEE Main and NEET students.

In this video:
0:00 A paper ball, a football, a hose: one curve
0:24 What is a trajectory?
0:45 Live sim: one throw, vx and vy, slow-mo at the top
1:15 Deriving the trajectory equation, step by step
1:58 Why the path is a parabola: y = ax - bx²
2:22 No gravity vs gravity + pause and think
2:56 What changes the curve? Faster throw, gentler bend
3:30 Worked example: height at 10 m
4:08 Exam trap: cos θ or cos² θ?
4:28 Practice question (JEE Main pattern)
5:09 Recap and three questions to answer

Next episode: Time of Flight. Same speed, 30° or 60°: which one stays in the air longer?
